claims.claim: At 75 percent of the speed of light, relativistic aberration concentrates diffusely scattered light in the forward direction, producing a recoil force that acts as drag on solar sails.

claims.claim: Analysis of 257 black hole mergers detected by LIGO, Virgo, and KAGRA revealed that objects near 10 solar masses appear in roughly three-quarters of events.
claims.episode_span: Analysis of 257 black hole mergers detected by LIGO, Virgo, and KAGRA revealed that objects near 10 solar masses appear in roughly three-quarters of events.
claims.source_title: A mysterious gap hints at black holes born from stars that never exploded
claims.supporting_quote: Black holes weighing roughly 10 times the mass of the Sun were exceptionally common, appearing in about three-quarters of the merger sample.
